title: Lakshya Sen Claims Kumamoto Masters Title, Second Season Win
indian_angle: Indian shuttler Lakshya Sen secured his second BWF Tour crown of the season, becoming the first Indian to win the Kumamoto Masters Japan.
summary: Lakshya Sen defeated Koki Watanabe in a thrilling final to clinch the Kumamoto Masters Japan Open, marking his second BWF Tour title this season and eyeing a spot in the BWF World Tour Finals.

title: BAI Elections Announced for December 26 in Guwahati
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India has announced its forthcoming elections, a key event for the sport's governance in the country.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has scheduled its elections for December 26, 2026, to be held in Guwahati, as per a recent press release.

title: 88th Senior National Badminton Championships Set for December in Bhubaneswar
indian_angle: The most prestigious domestic badminton event, the Senior National Championships, will bring together top Indian shuttlers in Bhubaneswar.
summary: The Yonex-Sunrise 79th Inter State – Inter Zonal & 88th Senior National Badminton Championships 2026 will take place in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, from December 17 to 24.

title: 49th Junior National Badminton Championships to Commence in Sikkim
indian_angle: This championship is crucial for identifying and nurturing the next generation of Indian badminton talent.
summary: The Yonex-Sunrise 49th Junior National Badminton Championships 2026 are scheduled to be held in Sikkim from November 14 to 21, with the eligibility list already released.

title: National Coaching Camp for BWF World Junior Championships in Guwahati
indian_angle: Indian junior players are undergoing intensive training at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati to prepare for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: A national coaching camp is underway at the National Center of Excellence (NCE) in Guwahati, preparing Indian shuttlers for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: Mini National Badminton Championships Venue Changed to Raipur
indian_angle: The change of venue for the Mini National Championships affects young Indian players and their participation plans.
summary: The Yonex-Sunrise 5th Mini National Badminton Championships 2026 have had their venue changed to Raipur, scheduled from November 24 to 27.
